evals.name: fueling-pull
evals.prompt: I've got a new fueling-duration run that just finished training on prod — run_id `ca30b35113ef429685724f7f62dbe73e`. Can you get it into the test repo so I can run test.py against it locally?
evals.expected_output: Command-level guidance that produces a canonical `<test-repo>/models/<tag>_<ddmmyyyy>_<run_id>/` directory from the specified MLflow run, using prod tracking server + Minio creds.

evals.name: uplift-kind-pull
evals.prompt: I want to check the latest uplift correction model against the previous version — MLflow run `950267949ce44f4db686d0692a4d4d4f`. Help me get it into the right place in the evaluation repo.
evals.expected_output: Guidance that correctly pulls the run as an uplift_correction (not plain uplift) model, lands it under flt-test-uplift-prediction/models/uplift_correction/, using prod creds. Must disambiguate uplift vs uplift_correction somehow — the artifact name alone is ambiguous (it's the algorithm name).

evals.name: k8s-train
evals.prompt: We want to retrain the schedule-predictor-minutes model on the kubernetes cluster in int env. Walk me through what command to run and what I need set up first.
evals.expected_output: A working `mlflow run` (or equivalent) command for kubernetes with espint.json backend-config. Prerequisites: docker login to ESP registry, MLFLOW_TRACKING_* env vars for int, horizon venv, possibly -Pengine oracle parameter.
